name: inboxq
tagline: Reads your mailbox, sorts what matters, proposes the rest.
description: Polls a connected mailbox over IMAP and classifies new mail into Focus, FYI, Auto, and Screened zones, with a plain-language daily report. Filing a message or blocking a sender are proposals recorded for a human decision, v1 never executes a mail action on its own. Governed by the same AEE-witnessed, per-org licence path every collector-native surface uses.
shortDescription: IMAP inbox triage: zones, a daily report, and human-decided proposals
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Polls a connected mailbox over IMAP and sorts new mail into Focus, FYI, Auto, and Screened
A daily report in plain language, not a dashboard you have to decode
Filing and blocking are proposals a human approves, v1 never moves or sends mail on its own
Single-org, IMAP-only in v1: no Gmail OAuth yet, read-first by design

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Every new message sorted into Focus, FYI, Auto, or Screened, with the flags that explain why.

dailyReport.name: Daily report
dailyReport.description: A generated, plain-language summary of what came in and what needs a look.

proposals.name: Proposals
proposals.description: Filing and blocking suggestions queued for a human decision. Approving records the decision; v1 defers execution.
